snippet.title: The Transference - Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
#steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3485290?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=releasedate&utm_medium=youtube

Escape from your own home, where you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person mystery thriller, full of family secrets and betrayals. Explore, solve puzzles, and find out who locked you up and why.

The Transference is a first-person mystery thriller where your own home has become your prison. Trapped inside a house with its doors and windows boarded up from the inside, you must explore every room, uncover hidden clues, and solve strange puzzles to find a way out. But escaping is only part of the mystery. As you investigate the house, you will uncover a disturbing story of family secrets and betrayals, while trying to discover who locked you inside and why.

Features:

- Explore your own home, now turned into a prison, and search every room for clues, hidden details, and secrets that could help you find a way out.
- Put your wits to the test with a wide variety of puzzles inspired by the Tower of Hanoi, the problem of the philosophers, and traditional games such as Seven and a Half.
- Investigate a mysterious story of family secrets and betrayals by examining objects, listening to testimonies, and connecting clues to uncover what really happened.
- Discover puzzles and challenges inspired by Spanish poets, famous stories and authors, as well as historical and cultural references from Andalusia and Spain.
- Stay alert as you explore the house. You are not alone, and sometimes you will need to hide, observe your surroundings, and find the right moment to move forward.
- Experience the entire story with full Spanish and English voice acting as you uncover the truth behind your captivity and the secrets hidden inside the house.
